K.ref: tasks/radiation-mznchallenge/PROVENANCE.md: K for generated instances is measured by running CP-SAT at 48× judging compute (7/10 proven optimal); for public repository instances, K is the best score among all 29 solvers in MiniZinc Challenge 2012.

status.notes: Final judging uses 36 instances: 24 generated instances and 12 MiniZinc repository instances. The 15 public practice instances (11 repository instances and 4 generated instances) are disjoint from final judging. K sources remain project measurements for generated instances and best scores from MiniZinc Challenge 2012 for repository instances.
